adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);` which becomes a no-op when `destinationCalendar` is `null`, silently discarding the collected co-host destination calendars. This is directly verifiable from the diff and results in missing calendar destinations in that configuration.
